original_source_root_role: Read-only legacy Steam extraction evidence; original VPK/DLL/firmware not copied by this task.

implementation_rules.terrain: Use independently generated VISION.H1V int16 world heights and original tree-only bitset. No navigation clearance or walkability blocking.
implementation_rules.height_quantization: nearest signed 32-world-unit level; higher levels block ground sight; unknown cells opaque.
implementation_rules.tree_line_of_sight: Integer octant shadowcasting, blocking tree cell is visible, cells behind are occluded. Dynamic planted tree invalidates cached masks.
implementation_rules.shared_team_sources: living heroes/creeps/structures/owned observer wards, fountains, captured watchers, roster area-vision fields and dropped Gem fields; sentries supply detection but no ground sight.
implementation_rules.pit: each sight or detection source respects cave-region boundaries; source in cave contributes to its team independently of another observer position. Renderer retains its own strict cave mask.
implementation_rules.true_sight: Only reveal invisible wards/item invisibility after shared ground-position visibility; does not provide ground sight or reveal Smoke/active Shadow Dance.
implementation_rules.slark: Enemy team position visibility, ignoring Slark target invisibility, disables only the passive; activation_delay and neutral_disable read original ability values. Active Shadow Dance concealment remains detection-immune.
implementation_rules.ward_health: 200 from item creation AbilityValues rather than the raw NPC default health100.
implementation_rules.ward_attack_model: H1 fixed hit model: real hero attacks100, nonhero attacks25, skills immune; normal in-flight attack allowed after shooter death. This 100/25 callback has not been decoded from original native engine and is an adaptation, not a claim of complete native equivalence.
implementation_rules.fog: current and explored bitsets in borrowed heap. Row spans equal exact original center-point circle comparison; no radius widening. Take Aim entire140-degree cone constrains both base and extended radius.
implementation_rules.failure: Missing terrain with workspace => flat ground radial/shared fog; missing workspace => fog0 and enemy hidden while own-team units remain visible.

limitations: 64-Source-unit grid and quantized height LOS are approximations, not the full Valve fog/vision engine.
Static baked map trees cannot be visually removed; their existing Tango cast remains rejected. Dynamic planted tree removal updates LOS.
Host and MIPS model tests do not establish physical H1 FPS, firmware scheduling, audio quality or full native-engine compatibility.

exact_performance_caches.slope_precompute: Exact original signed Q16 divisions once at terrain attach; no per-cell DIV in cast.
exact_performance_caches.circle_reach: 16 lazy budget-keyed LRU entries,1041 uint16 values and33-word validity mask each. Cache key budget=radius^2>>4, value=floor(sqrt(budget-dy^2)); misses use unchanged integer root. Eviction clears only valid bits.
exact_performance_caches.obstruction: plot reuses the same pure wall result already computed by cast.
